meta.title: Martina Álvarez — Underwater photography
meta.description: Underwater photography and filmmaking by Martina Álvarez. A journey through the ocean, sharks and the stories that connect us to marine life.

surface.name: Martina Álvarez
surface.tagline: You don't look at the ocean. You descend into it.
surface.descent: The surface slips away. The blue surrounds us.

portfolio.title: Where light still reaches
portfolio.intro: A selection from the sunlit zone: schooling fish, reefs, and the first blue.

1.title: The twilight zone
1.body: Three weeks tracking the largest vertical migration on Earth: every night, millions of creatures rise from the gloom toward the surface and sink back before dawn.

2.title: The last corals
2.body: A record of bleaching on remote reefs. What looks like snow is a funeral: the coral expels the algae that feeds and keeps it alive.

3.title: Bioluminescence
3.body: Where the sun no longer reaches, life makes its own light. A year chasing flashes in total darkness.

about.title: About
about.body: I'm a marine photographer and documentarian. Twelve years ago I traded the studio for cold water. I work with natural light and held breath: I descend, I watch, I wait. The ocean does the rest.

contact.title: In the dark, a single point of light
contact.body: A commission, an expedition, a story to tell? Write to me.

entry.label: A view beneath the surface
entry.title: Slow down.
entry.note: Follow the descent. Let life come closer.

reef.label: The submerged garden
reef.title: Everything seems still.
reef.body: A landscape within a landscape. Tiny forms, textures and encounters emerge when we pause to look. The first image begins long before the shutter.
reef.note: Explore the photographs to see every detail.
reef.caption: Reef / forms of life

open.label: In the world of sharks
open.title: Sharks.
open.body: Sharks are central to Martina’s work. As a photographer, diver and underwater filmmaker specializing in them, she brings us closer through observation, respect and the stories of the people who protect them.
open.note: Getting to know them changes how we see the ocean.
open.caption: Shark / face to face
open.project: A story of love for sharks

whale.label: The twilight zone
whale.title: Suddenly,
whale.body: The frame opens up. A silhouette crosses the water and, for a moment, everything finds its scale. Photographing the ocean is also learning to wait.
whale.caption: An encounter in the blue

about.label: Behind the gaze
about.title: First, dive.
about.body: Martina Álvarez is a marine photographer, diver and underwater filmmaker with a particular focus on sharks. The creator of Women of the Ocean Club, she brings exploration and ocean stories together to connect more people with life beneath the surface.
about.caption: Light / what remains
